title: 1997 Circa #191 Craig Paquette Kansas City Royals Baseball Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
Elevate your collection with the 1997 Circa #191 featuring Craig Paquette of the Kansas City Royals. A must-have for baseball aficionados, this card captures the essence of the MLB experience during a memorable season. Produced by Fleer/SkyBox International, it's a noteworthy piece for both the player's career and the sport's rich history.

While this card is not autographed, its pristine presentation embodies the spirit of the game and the era. A true representation of the time, it’s a tangible slice of baseball’s legacy, ideal for fans of the sport or collectors seeking to commemorate the 1997 Kansas City Royals team.
